h1: Mike's Painting & Pressure Washing vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: In a humid climate, the wash before the paint matters as much as the paint itself. Here is how to judge the cleaning and mildew steps on any painting proposal.

sections.h2: Comparing the cleaning step, not just the painting
body: Mike's Painting & Pressure Washing is one of the painting and property-service companies homeowners in North Central Florida may be comparing with Precision Paint Experts. We do not comment on other businesses. This page zeroes in on a stage of the job that is easy to skim past on a quote: getting the surface clean, free of mildew, and dry before any coating goes on.

Green and black growth on the north side of a house, pollen film on trim, and chalky old paint all keep new paint from bonding properly. Washing is not a courtesy step; it is the foundation for everything that follows.

High pressure is useful on concrete and some masonry, but it can force water into siding joints and damage soft wood or older stucco. Soft washing uses lower pressure with cleaning solutions to remove growth without that risk. Precision Paint Experts offers both through our pressure washing and soft washing service, and the method is chosen per surface.
If you are seeing dark streaks or fuzzy patches, our guide to mold and mildew on siding covers what that growth is and why it comes back when it is only rinsed off.

Concrete is a different story. Driveways, walks, and pool decks can usually take more pressure, and cleaning them at the same time as the house means the whole property looks finished when the crew leaves. If you want those surfaces included, ask for them to be listed by name on the estimate so there is no doubt about the scope.

sections.h2: What a solid prep scope says about washing
body: Whoever you hire, the estimate should answer these points in writing:
bullets: Which surfaces are washed, and by what method.
Whether a mildew treatment is applied, not only a rinse.
How long surfaces dry before primer or paint.
How plants, screens, and outlets are protected during washing.
What happens to loose paint exposed by the wash: scraping, sanding, spot-priming.

sections.h2: Where washing fits in our process
body: Our sequence runs walkthrough, written estimate, prep days, application, and a punch walk you sign. Prep days include washing, mildew treatment, scraping, sanding, nail pops, rot and fascia replacement, re-caulking, and spot-priming. A full exterior usually takes three to seven working days plus washing and dry time, and we state that on the schedule rather than hiding it.

During the walkthrough, the crew lead takes moisture readings where needed, because paint over damp siding is a frequent cause of failure. Our article on humidity and peeling paint explains the connection.

Estimates are free, with no obligation, and usually arrive within one business day of the walkthrough. We follow the wash with premium 100% acrylic on siding and trim and back the result with a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years on exterior projects. Book a walkthrough or read about exterior painting in more detail.

faqs.q: Is washing included in your exterior painting estimates?
faqs.a: Washing and mildew treatment are part of our prep days on exterior repaints, and the estimate lists the method and surfaces.

faqs.q: Can I book soft washing without painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Pressure washing and soft washing are offered as standalone services as well as painting prep.

faqs.q: Why does mildew come back after I rinse it?
faqs.a: Rinsing removes the visible layer but not always the growth itself. A mildew treatment is applied as part of our prep before any coating.
